description:
Execute a SQL query against a Quorum database connection.

Reads run in a read-only session; masked columns stay masked. For changes, use quorum_propose_write: a person approves them in Quorum. (Only when Quorum is set to run allowed writes directly does a write run here, and then UPDATE or DELETE without WHERE, PROD and CRITICAL writes, DDL and TRUNCATE off LOCAL, and writes on connections that need review, a ticket or a cool-down are refused.)
Results are limited by the connection's row limit (configurable in Quorum).

Args:
  - connection_id: UUID from quorum_list_connections
  - sql: SQL query to execute
  - row_limit: Optional override for result row limit

Returns columns, rows, row count, and duration.

row_limit.description: Maximum rows to return (default: connection row limit)

name: quorum_execute_query
title: Execute SQL via Quorum
